## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a reproduction or issue where useful.

## Verification

List the commands/results and any unverified parts. Include evidence appropriate
to the change: FEN/perft for rules, integer parity for kernels/export, controlled
match settings/verdict for strength, or executable examples/site checks for docs.

## Compatibility

State changes to commands, options, JSON/FEN, dataset/network formats, or shipped
weights. For an intentional signature change, include regenerated counts and why.
